scripts.dev:stop: pkill -f "tsx watch src/main.ts" 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f "next dev -p 3000" 2>/dev/null || true; (lsof -nP -iTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN -t; lsof -nP -iTCP:4000 -sTCP:LISTEN -t) 2>/dev/null | sort -u | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev: npm run dev:stop && (npm run dev -w @civic/api & npm run dev -w @civic/web)
scripts.web:clean: bash -lc "rm -rf apps/web/.next apps/web/.next-dev apps/web/.next-prod apps/web/.next_cache_* apps/web/.next-dev_cache_* apps/web/.next-prod_cache_*"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @civic/api && npm run build -w @civic/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @civic/api && npm run lint -w @civic/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @civic/api && npm run typecheck -w @civic/web
